issue_notes: The govt's 'economic terrorist' / Rs 1.5L cr Kaleshwaram-failure charge is the main anti-BRS line.
Counter-attacks recycle corruption-under-BRS and barrage-maintenance arguments.
Off-handle name-variant chatter stayed pro-BRS this window - unusual for KTR.
His base was clearly mobilised by the farmers-water agitation.

top_posts.text: My son Himanshu suffered a minor sports injury; he should be back to normal in a few days. Thank you for the concern.
You say you'll sprinkle our blood? Bloodthirsty demon! Take our blood - but give the farmers water.
It feels like you were a toddler holding my hand just yesterday - happy 21st, Himanshu.
When the World Bank validates Telangana's economic transformation, it is global recognition of KCR Garu's vision.
Had the pleasure of inaugurating the India facility of Kandou AI in Hyderabad.

topic_notes: Kaleshwaram and the farmers-water agitation dominated his coverage.
The World Bank tag reopened the KCR-legacy credit war on favourable terms.
His Shabad law-and-order attack kept pressure on the government.
Personal posts (son's injury, S. Janaki tribute) drew the highest reach.

insights: The fortnight flipped KTR positive: the Kaleshwaram farmers-water agitation and Revanth's 'blood' remark handed BRS the moral high ground and mobilised the base.
